title: General Visiting Hours
content: General visiting hours are from 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM. Access may be restricted during emergencies, outbreaks, or other operational circumstances.

title: Visitor Identification
content: Visitors may be required to carry or display an authorized visitor pass and comply with identification requirements.

title: Number of Visitors
content: Normally, no more than two visitors should be present with a patient at one time unless the department grants an exception.

title: ICU Visiting
content: ICU access is restricted to authorized visitors. Visit duration and visitor numbers may be limited according to clinical and operational requirements.

title: Emergency Department Access
content: The emergency department operates for urgent care. Visitors and accompanying persons must follow staff instructions and access restrictions.

title: Patient Registration
content: Patients must provide required identification and registration information before receiving routine hospital services, subject to emergency-care exceptions.

title: Appointment Booking
content: Appointments should be scheduled through approved hospital booking channels. Patients should provide accurate contact and identification information.

title: Appointment Cancellation
content: Patients should cancel appointments as early as possible through approved hospital channels so appointment capacity can be managed efficiently.

title: Appointment Rescheduling
content: Requests to reschedule appointments should be made through approved booking channels and are subject to available slots.

title: Late or Missed Appointments
content: Patients who are late or miss an appointment should contact the relevant department promptly. Rescheduling may depend on availability.

title: Patient Identification
content: Patient identity should be verified using the hospital's approved identification process before relevant services are provided.

title: Patient Privacy
content: Patient information must be accessed, used, and disclosed only in accordance with applicable privacy requirements and hospital procedures.

title: Medical Records Access
content: Requests for medical records must follow the hospital's records-access procedure and may require identity verification or authorization.

title: Representative Access to Records
content: A representative may access records only when appropriate authorization and identification requirements have been satisfied.

title: Medication Disclosure
content: Patients should provide the care team with an accurate list of medicines, supplements, and relevant allergies. Medication changes require appropriate clinical guidance.

title: Medication Administration
content: Medicines administered during hospital care must follow authorized clinical orders and hospital medication-safety procedures.

title: Infection Prevention
content: Patients, visitors, and staff must follow applicable hand hygiene, protective equipment, isolation, and infection-control instructions.

title: Isolation Precautions
content: Patients placed under isolation precautions and their visitors must follow department instructions regarding protective equipment and movement.

title: Smoking and Tobacco
content: Smoking and tobacco use are prohibited in designated hospital premises according to hospital rules and applicable regulations.

title: Photography and Recording
content: Photography, video, or audio recording in clinical areas may be restricted to protect patient privacy and confidentiality.

title: Billing and Payments
content: Patients are responsible for following the hospital's billing and payment procedures. Insurance coverage should be verified with the relevant billing or insurance desk.

title: Patient Complaints and Feedback
content: Patients may submit feedback or complaints through the hospital's designated patient-relations or grievance process.

title: Discharge Procedure
content: Discharge should follow the treating team's instructions. Patients should receive relevant discharge information, medication instructions, and follow-up guidance as applicable.

title: Accessibility Assistance
content: Patients who require accessibility or mobility assistance should notify the hospital so reasonable available support can be arranged.

title: Emergency Escalation
content: Urgent or life-threatening situations should be handled through emergency medical services or hospital emergency staff. The AI assistant must not delay emergency care.
